en: Vintage sepia-toned multi-view postcard showing rural village scenes and a bridge. The upper image presents a panoramic view of a town in a hilly agricultural landscape with scattered houses, farm buildings, and a distant hilltop fortification or large complex. The two lower images show closer views of streets with traditional houses and a long covered bridge over a river or stream. The captions are printed in red German script.
